body: Just tried this and confirmed. That's weird...

It looks like there's a problem with how [comments are collected and calculated](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/blob/ef341be49669230bb33c76886c666be89c8e99ee/lib/rules/newline-before-return.js#L107-L109). @anton-rudeshko are you interested in submitting a PR?
Yeah, but not sure yet if I can find time for that. Will try. At least it's a known bug now.
@anton-rudeshko @btmills do you want me to send a pul request for this.
@diki I don't mind ) Make the world a better place if you can ;)

The proposed solution in the PR looks good to me, though I can't help but wonder why comments inside the previous token are getting returned at all. It only seems to be an issue when the previous object/block ~~only contain a comment and nothing else~~ see comment in PR. Granted, I don't see the point of having an empty block or object literal with a comment inside of it, but is that the expected behavior of `sourceCode.getComments(node).leading`?

If not, I can make an issue and look into fixing that.

EDIT: Much better and more accurate description in the [PR](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/pull/5512#issuecomment-193812837)

This issue is similar to #5531 (raising as a separate issue on request of @kaicataldo).

`// no default` comment in a `SwitchCase` triggers `newline-before-return` error.

**What version of ESLint are you using?**
2.5.3

**What parser (default, Babel-ESLint, etc.) are you using?**
babel-eslint

**Please show your full configuration:**

```
/* eslint
    newline-before-return: 'error'
    default-case: 'error'
*/
```

**What did you do? Please include the actual source code causing the issue.**

```
function foo() {
    switch ("foo") {
        case "foo":
            break;

        // no default
    }

    return;
}

foo();
```

**What did you expect to happen?**
No errors

**What actually happened? Please include the actual, raw output from ESLint.**

```
$ eslint foo.js

foo.js
  9:2  error  Expected newline before return statement  newline-before-return

✖ 1 problem (1 error, 0 warnings)
```

Removing the comment fixes the error (but clashes with `default-case`)
